pages.title: Coach home (redirect)
pages.where: Not a page coaches open; it passes them straight on
pages.summary: Nothing to do here: the page checks who is signed in and sends coaches on to Academy → Community.
pages.notes: Coaches only see "Redirecting…" for a moment before landing on the Academy Community page. If the coach's record is missing they see an error saying to ask an admin to set it up. Admins not viewing as a coach are sent to the admin area, so Ava should not offer this page.

pages.title: Classroom
pages.where: Academy → Classroom
pages.summary: Browse the training courses, open one to start learning, and see how far you have got in each.
controls: Course cards (Start Here, Coach Action Plan, Going Pro, Get Calls, Win Clients, Coach Clients) with a picture, a short label such as Onboarding, Strategy, Foundations, Marketing, Sales or Delivery, a title and a description
Progress bar on each course card, with a percentage and a count such as '3 of 12 complete'
**The Portfolio System** banner under the course cards, with an arrow strip to open the map (**Open the map** on small screens)
**The Vault** box at the bottom with a **Show** / **Hide** arrow to open or fold it
Vault course cards inside The Vault: Personal growth, Book summaries and Tools & set-up
A row of single talks from other coaches in the Vault, each with a video picture, length, title and speaker name
pages.notes: Clicking a course card opens its first lesson. The Vault starts folded for new coaches and opens by itself once you have started a Vault lesson; Show or Hide is remembered on this device. Lessons marked as drafts are hidden from coaches and only admins see them.

pages.title: Classroom course entry
pages.where: Academy → Classroom
pages.summary: This page has nothing on screen; it sends the coach straight to the first lesson of the chosen course, or back to the Classroom list if the course is retired or empty.
pages.notes: Coaches never see this page itself, only the lesson it redirects to. Do not describe it as a place to go; point coaches to Academy → Classroom and the course's lessons instead.

pages.title: System
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → System (or open the Classroom and choose the lead flow map)
pages.summary: See the whole path from finding ideal clients to keeping them as one map, and open the lesson behind each step.
controls: **Classroom** back link at the top left, returns to the Classroom
Step 1 **Find Your Ideal Clients** cards: Choose Your Ideal Client, Define the Problem You Solve, Build Your Prospect List
Step 2 **Set Up Your Pipeline** cards: Optimise Your LinkedIn Profile, Create Your Lead Capture, Set Up Your Call Booking

Step 3 **Lead Generation & Win Clients** flow map with boxes such as Prospect Lists, Interest Sequence, Reply Sequence, Discovery Call, Value Session, New Client, and decision diamonds Reachable?, Interested?, Booked?, Qualified?, Won?
**Customise funnel** button in the step 3 header, opens the funnel settings
**Reachable**, **Interested**, **Booked**, **Qualified**, **Won** sliders in the funnel settings, they change the numbers on the map
**New clients** box with minus and plus buttons in the funnel settings, how many new clients you want
**Reset** button in the funnel settings, puts the default rates back
**Close funnel settings** (X) button in the funnel settings
Step 4 **Build Authority** cards: Run Your Newsletter, Email Your List, Post on Social
Step 5 **Keep Clients** cards: Onboard New Clients, Deliver Coaching, Retain & Renew
Hover over or focus a card or map box to see a summary and an **Open lesson** button
Click a map box to open a detail box under the map, with **Close** and **Open lesson**
**Show sample messages** drop-down on the Interest Sequence hover card
pages.notes: Funnel settings are saved in the coach's own browser only. Newsletter, Email Your List, Post on Social and a few map boxes show no lesson yet (Lesson coming soon). Info (i) icons in each step header show what the step is for.}

pages.title: Weekly Focus
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → This Week's Focus (open from the Classroom page; the Classroom link at the top of this page takes you back)
pages.summary: Read this week's focus and action, listen to the audio or read the lesson, and look back at earlier weeks.
controls: **Classroom** link at the top, goes back to the Classroom
**This Week’s Focus** label (shows **Past Focus** when you open an earlier week), with the title and a short description
**This Week’s Action** box with the action to do this week
**Listen** audio player, shown only when that week has audio
Lesson text under the action, shown only when that week has text
**Open** button (named after the learning path, e.g. Open + path name) opens the related path in the Classroom
**Back to this week** button, shown only when viewing a past week
**Past weeks** list with the week number, path, title and action for each week
**Open** link on each past week row
pages.notes: The audio and lesson text load a moment after the page and only appear for a signed-in coach. The Past weeks list only shows once there are earlier weeks.  Weeks are shown by number, with no streaks.

pages.title: Weekly focus
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → open a weekly focus (this week's or a past week)
pages.summary: Read one week's focus, do its action, listen to the audio, and jump into the related learning path.
controls: **Classroom** link at the top, goes back to the Classroom
**This Week’s Focus** or **Past Focus** label above the title (past weeks also show the week number)
**This week’s action** box with the one thing to do
**Listen** audio player, shown only when the week has audio
Lesson text under the action, shown only when the week has it
**Open** button at the bottom, named after the related path, goes to that learning path
**Back to this week** button, shown only on a past week
**Past weeks** list with a row for each earlier week, each with an **Open** link
pages.notes: The audio and lesson text load a moment after the page, and only appear if that week has them. The Past weeks list only appears once there are earlier weeks. An unknown week link shows a not-found page.

pages.title: The Resource Library

**Keep clients** section: opens to list its resources (masterfile, Sessions 1 to 4, how to open and close)

**Overview** link in the left contents list
**Search inside resources** box in the left contents list
**Contents** button on phones to open or fold the left list

**The old Resources list** link at the bottom of the left list

pages.title: One resource page
pages.where: Academy → Resources → pick a page
pages.summary: Read one resource page (a guide, sheet, slide deck, file, video or reading list) and copy, download or open what it links to.

**View the master** button on a sheet, opens the original
**Open** button on a slide deck, opens it in Google Slides
**Download** button on a file, saves it to your computer
**Open in Drive** button on a file
**How to run it** link beside a group of sheet tabs, opens the matching guide page
**Watch the video** button, shown when a video can't play on the page
Sheet tab list under **The tabs**, each tab links to that part of the sheet
**Previous** and **Next** links at the bottom, to read through the whole library in order

Which buttons appear depends on what the page holds. Slide decks and Office files show a preview on the page, but Keynote files can only be downloaded.

pages.title: Resources (link list)
pages.where: Academy → Resources → ← The Resource Library link leads back; this list is the original link version of the Resources page
pages.summary: Browse or search the Academy's resource links and open any of them in a new tab.
controls: **← The Resource Library** link at the top, goes back to the Resource Library page
Area switch at the top with one button per area (for example Profit system); the other area names come from the app's area list
**Search resources…** box, searches title, topic, link and section name
**Resource** column: each title is a link that opens in a new tab
**Topic** column: only shown while searching
**Type** column: badge such as Document, Spreadsheet, Video or PDF
Section and topic header rows with a count: click to open or close them
**Open full document** link inside a one-file group, opens the whole file
Line under the search showing how many resources are in the chosen area
**No resources match your search.** message when a search finds nothing
pages.notes: This is the older list kept while the Resource Library is on test, so it may not appear in the sidebar. The trash icon and 'Admin mode' note are admin-only and coaches never see them. The exact area names come from a list not shown in the code, so only describe them if the coach sees them.

pages.title: Ava
pages.where: Not shown in the sidebar or section tabs given; open the Ava page at /coach/ava
pages.summary: This is the full-page home of Ava, the AI assistant, where a coach can ask for help finding things in the app.
pages.notes: The page code only loads Ava's page and does not show its labels or buttons, so do not describe specific buttons or fields here. There is no sidebar link for it in the names provided.

pages.title: My Blueprint
pages.where: My Blueprint (in the sidebar, under coach tools)
pages.summary: See your Blueprint pages and how far each one has got, and work through the setup checklist to get your campaign live.
controls: **Your Blueprint** heading with a **?** button (How your Blueprint works) that opens a pop-up with Where you are, a video and how status works
**List** / **Board** switch at the top right: List shows pages in groups, Board shows a card per page in columns by status
**Get set up** checklist (folds open and shut) with a count like '3 of 10 done' and a progress bar

Checklist steps: **Connect LinkedIn**, **Fill in About You**, **Connect your email**, **Have your Blueprint Call**, **Update your LinkedIn profile**, **Review your prospects**, **Review your campaign**, **Put the app on your phone**, **Turn on reply alerts**, **Go live**
Step buttons: **Connect**, **Open**, **Book a time**, **I've done it**, **Looks good**, **Review**, **Show me**, **Set up**, plus quick links **See it** and **See them**
Blue bar **BCA is waiting on you** (or '[number] messages from BCA are waiting for you'), shown only when there are replies waiting; click it to open the chat
Page rows in List: each shows the title, a short line, a chat count or '[number] new', and a status label; click one to open that page
Statuses: **Needs you**, **BCA**, **In progress**, **Review**, **Done**
Board columns hold the same page cards, one column per status
pages.notes: The 'Get set up' steps need LinkedIn, email and reply alerts connected in Settings → Integrations; the app ticks what it can see, and you tick 'Update your LinkedIn profile' and 'Review your prospects' yourself. The Checklist/Timeline switch in the top bar is admin-only, so coaches only ever see the checklist. Each Blueprint page below the overview has its own chat and a 'Sign off this page' button when a page is in Review.

pages.title: One Blueprint page

pages.summary: Read and fill in one page of your practice plan, answering your boxes and checking what BCA has written for you.

Grey answer boxes: type and they save when you click out, with a small **Saved** tick
**Add another result** / **Add another story** in results and client stories cards
**Add a role** in your career list, with a tick box to use or leave out each role and **Show more** for long careers
**Add** and **Add your own** for lists and pick-from options
**What BCA recommends** link that opens a tip in some sections
**More actions** (the three dots) on a written section: **Rewrite**, **Copy**, **Ask for a change**
**Send to BCA** box after Ask for a change
**Write it now** button in a section BCA has not written yet
**Create the…** button under written campaign messages, under the heading **Happy with it? Send it to Get Clients**
**How to do it, in the Classroom** links at the bottom of a page
**Talk it through with Ava** link under results and stories
Part buttons at the top of a long page like About You to jump to each part, ticked when done
pages.notes: Opens on its own from a link; the page title is shown by the Blueprint layout around it, not here. Pages named blueprint or command do not exist here. The Decision Record page is read-only for coaches (Edit is admin-only), and the build-everything bar and Who does what group are not shown to coaches.

pages.title: Practice Blueprint (whole document)

Chapter headings with page titles, each page made of sections
Part buttons at the top of a long page (such as About you), ticked when done
Grey answer boxes you type in, saved when you click away, with a **Saved** tick
**Add another result** / **Add another story** / **Add a role** / **Add** / **Add a row** buttons
**Where was this result?** choices: In a job, My own business, Current client, Past client
**What BCA recommends** link to show BCA's tip in a section
**…** (More actions) menu on written sections: Rewrite, Copy, Ask for a change
**Send to BCA** after typing a change request
**Happy with it? Send it to Get Clients** box with a Create button, on campaign sections
**How to do it, in the Classroom** links at the end of a page
**Why we build it for you** welcome video from Zander
pages.notes: The Write my blueprint bar, the Write it now buttons and the Decision Record Edit button are not shown to coaches, because BCA writes the sections and admins fill in the Decision Record. Written sections appear once BCA has drafted them. Coaches can read the Decision Record on its page but not edit it.

pages.title: Your plan (jobs list)

pages.notes: Coaches never see this page: it redirects them to My Blueprint. Do not send a coach here or describe its list, board or job pages. Everything on it (Your plan, List/Board toggle, jobs, Anything else) is admin only for now.

pages.title: BOSS Score

**+ Add new person** option in the list, then fill in their details and click **Start session**

**Change** option in the same menu to pick someone else
Score boxes in the BOSS grid (**Areas**) - click to score each playbook; scores save by themselves and a green **Scores saved.** message appears
Playbook notes inside the grid for each playbook
Score dials for the total score and the three pillars
**Charts** box with **Score breakdown** and **Your focus areas** (only when scoring is switched off and there are scores)
**Owner level completeness** bars
**BOSS wheel**
Answer mix bar showing on track, building, needs attention and not answered
**Insights** box with a refresh button (**Refresh insights**); topic tabs **Overview**, **Levels**, **Pillars**, **Areas**; **See full overview** button opens a pop-up with **Your Top 3 Priorities**
**Priority playbooks** chips under each insight, which open the playbook
pages.notes: Nothing is scored until a contact is picked; before that the page is greyed out behind the picker. The Insights box only shows once a contact is chosen and takes a short time to write. The prospect priority matrix and the coach picker are admin-only, so never offer them.The **Score together** checkbox is hidden for coaches.

pages.title: Calls
pages.where: Get Clients → Calls

**Filter** button (in Calendar view: Calendars and Type; in List view: Timing and Call status)

**Today**, previous and next arrows, and **Day** / **Week** / **Month** buttons in Calendar view

List columns: **Prospect**, **Contact info**, **Date added**, **Call time**, **Calendar**, **Call status** (a drop-down you can change for calls booked in Profit Coach)
In Settings: **Booking calendars** list with **New calendar**, an on/off switch, a copy-link button and an **Edit** / **Delete** menu for each calendar
In Settings: **Weekly hours** box with **Timezone**, day checkboxes and **Save hours**
In Settings: **Calendar provider** choice between **Profit Coach calendars** and **CRM calendar**, with **Save CRM details**
In Settings: **Calls** link at the top goes back to your calls
pages.notes: Clicking a call row in the list opens that person's BOSS Score page only if your account has access to client tools. The calendar shows your Google or Outlook events only after you press **Connect calendar** (in Settings); bookings work without it. The Coach column and coach filter are admin-only, so don't offer them.}

The Pool tab content is not shown in this code, so it is not described here.
